newsitem.title: CANADA: Polydex revenue rebounding after drought.
newsitem.headline: Polydex revenue rebounding after drought.

text.p: Polydex Pharmaceuticals Ltd said revenues were rebounding after a drought in the U.S. Midwest caused them to slip in the company's second quarter.

The company said the drought reduced revenue in the second quarter ended July 31 to $1,902,118 from $1,990,817 in the same period a year earlier. The company reported a second-quarter loss from operations of $278,182 compared with a loss from operations of $97,481 in the 1995 quarter.
The company said the drought, which began in May, forced farmers to cut back orders for iron dextran, the principal product of its subsidiary, Vet Labs.
Iron dextran is an injectible dietary supplement used to prevent anemia in piglets.
"Revenues are rebounding in the current quarter," the company said, "and prices are improving."
